entry.confirm_signal: Two short tones, then the tone series of the first parameter.
steps: Transmitter on with throttle at full.
Connect the battery: three ascending tones, then two short tones (full throttle accepted).
Keep full throttle for more than 5 s (do not lower the stick): the ESC plays another tone series and enters programming.
Two short tones, then the tones of parameter 1.

announce.description: Parameters sound as tones: 1-4 short tones = parameter 1-4; one long = 5; long plus 1-4 short = 6-9; two long = 10; two long plus 1-2 short = 11-12. Options of a selected parameter sound with the same code (option N = same tones as parameter N).

select.description: Select a parameter by moving the stick to the bottom position within 3 s of its tones. Choose an option by moving the stick to full throttle during its tones.

skip.description: Do not move the stick within 3 s: the ESC goes on to the next parameter. If nothing is selected the list repeats.

scheme.confirm_signal: After a selection the ESC continues down the parameter list; no separate stored-tone is named.
scheme.exit: Select parameter 13 (two long tones plus a series of short tones), then lower the throttle: the ESC arms.
scheme.reset_to_defaults: Parameter 12 (two long, two short tones): factory reset.
scheme.description: Full throttle at power-up for more than 5 s after the two acceptance tones enters programming. Parameters sound in sequence as short and long tones; bottom stick within 3 s selects one, full throttle selects an option, and the list continues. Parameter 13 saves and exits.

unknowns: Tone durations of short and long tones and the gap between tones: not stated.
How long the ESC holds a parameter's tones before moving on: the manual gives only the 3 s window for selecting.
How options sound inside a parameter: the manual says the options are announced by tones; the one-short/two-short column headers of the options table are used for the option numbers.
Entry timing: programming starts when more than 5 s pass at full throttle after the two short tones; exact moment not stated.
Whether the options list wraps after the last option: the manual says the list cycles.
Exit tones and the 'series of short tones' count for parameter 13: not stated.
The manual says parameter 12 factory reset has an empty options cell; the confirmation of a reset is not described.
Defaults come from black table cells in the page image.
notes: The list of parameters (13) in this manual includes factory reset and exit as items 12 and 13; Spektrum_Avian_130Pro.pdf lists 15 parameters with no reset and no exit item, while its text still says to select the last parameter (#13) to save and exit.
